scope: Lewisville, Texas; the separately hosted Nautique Dealer Texas blog links to the main dealer site.

metrics.label: Locations presented on the website
metrics.context: Lewisville headquarters and seasonal Long Cove Marina location; a website fact, not a performance metric.

observations.title: Make a first demo easier to request
observations.observed: The demo form requires visitors to type which boat they want and correctly explains that their chosen date is only a request.
observations.improvement: Test a model selector with an "I'm not sure yet" path based on activity and group size. Keep the requested-date caveat and explain confirmation.

observations.title: Connect educational content to the next step
observations.observed: The separate Nautique Dealer Texas blog links readers to Buxton’s main inventory and contact pages.
observations.improvement: Test one model-specific inventory or demo link per relevant article. Keep branding consistent and measure article-to-inquiry progression before a migration.

limitations: The older event-specific URL was unavailable for review. The blog homepage links establish its relationship with the main dealer site.
Public website review only. No forms submitted or mobile-usability, conversion, speed or internal-system tests performed.
